en.title: HyperStyler: Low-resource Authorship Style Transfer via Hypernetworks
en.hook: Rewrite text in any author's unique style using just a few reference examples while preserving semantic meaning.
key_takeaways: Advancing low-resource authorship style transfer (LAST) techniques
Context-aware style navigation for precise author imitation
Preserving original semantics using advanced hypernetwork architectures
